mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_vehicle_state (vehicle_id, state_json) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{json}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vehicle_id = vehicle_id
mapper.select: SELECT state_json FROM alert_vehicle_state WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_vehicle_state SET state_json = #{json} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recognition_record WHERE source_key = #{sourceKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recognition_record (source_key, source_frame_id, camera_id, vehicle_id, driver_id, fleet_id, captured_at, pred, behavior_code, max_p, energy, knn_dist, ood, participated, decision_reason, speed_kmh, speed_status, key_frame_path, names_captured, plate_no_snapshot, driver_name_snapshot, fleet_name_snapshot) VALUES (#{sourceKey}, #{sourceFrameId}, #{cameraId}, #{vehicleId}, #{driverId}, #{fleetId}, #{capturedAt}, #{pred}, #{behaviorCode}, #{maxP}, #{energy}, #{knnDist}, #{ood}, #{participated}, #{decisionReason}, #{speedKmh}, #{speedStatus}, #{keyFramePath}, 1, (SELECT plate_no FROM vehicle WHERE id=#{vehicleId}), (SELECT name FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{driverId}), (SELECT name FROM fleet WHERE id=#{fleetId}))

INSERT INTO alert_record (recognition_id, camera_id, vehicle_id, driver_id, fleet_id, captured_at, behavior_code, max_p, record_type, event_count, sms_status, key_frame_path) VALUES (#{recognitionId}, #{cameraId}, #{vehicleId}, #{driverId}, #{fleetId}, #{capturedAt}, #{behaviorCode}, #{maxP}, #{recordType}, #{eventCount}, #{smsStatus}, #{keyFramePath})
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM alert_record a WHERE a.recognition_id = #{recognitionId} AND a.sms_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sms_delivery d WHERE d.alert_id = a.id) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_record a SET sms_status = 'SENDING' WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.sms_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sms_delivery d WHERE d.alert_id = a.id)
UPDATE alert_record SET sms_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND sms_status = 'SENDING'
